## Streamex Corp. to Participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference


September 23, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.streamex.com/node/12446/pdf)


WINTER PARK, Fla., Sept. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Streamex Corp. (“Streamex” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: STEX), a technology company building the future of the commodity markets through tokenization, will participate in a webcast presentation and host one-on-one meetings with investors at the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, taking place virtually on September 29, 2026.


**Company Webcast**


The webcast presentation will take place at 3:30 p.m. ET on Tuesday, September 29, 2026. The webcast can be accessed by visiting the conference website at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tyXATMBPSI9eN7Oa-vnPNrkZE1tJOjcmnXxt4QAb2T4SCHWqX24eUhWxiyq6GY2OgMJdOLPK4ewim1fbGYbToOxK56sxvvgOK0xcQeyUEdBcoH2mhcUj8ZTgEk-oH80Fen5kEGtr_rPJDDZhs8zoOQ==) or directly at[https://app.webinar.net/E2lpqML7me1](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tyXATMBPSI9eN7Oa-vnPNrtZfmRo9WJJlPnC_qstSx8ZSltzUBShVAdv9Vf0sgwlUpB_8anl15mTtrQIQn71NlF_fsfR1px6Z35z2Wn1gwE_EP3j1wGfCKWKDr5El7ZVByIFEh0sR20xo-lsU6W_Ig==) . The webcast will also be available for replay following the event on the company’s website at[https://ir.streamex.com/news-events/events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tyXATMBPSI9eN7Oa-vnPNuVa-_cYqnE8aB_PIkkmzLGUWVBlbL1YPPwZg-zqDhKw1KEvv6hoiDMxbEgIY3McX0MJ54HGNELPIOpgvRxaIrM9lvQ4jMwSJ_VZCs34uvpxormdEbGxBp6wmTA1Ax_rsA==) .


**1x1 Meetings**


Management will be participating in virtual one-on-one meetings throughout the event. To arrange a meeting with management, please contact Lytham Partners at[1x1@lythampartners.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nFQ4N48HQIWILW9WDFjnWvmkUxwzyVm_jIhu9-THBuKle2hsOOWugQFIWBqbxCY-hebsk0M5W7l1pm5WwiPuCx7S7TiJrsnHhOBxKlDbNy0=) or register for the event at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026invreg/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tyXATMBPSI9eN7Oa-vnPNrkZE1tJOjcmnXxt4QAb2T6rTEP9wt4NZ8QNeqEU5XxM1kicWYlzuwdj-C43vHo5rLoPf-THKRtkH40vP-8xSIFT5AWCq8CUwjm3OTCdYe5r3-qCQkw9IIIqIuv5aNXpiw==) .


**About Streamex Corp.**


Streamex Corp. (NASDAQ: STEX) is a technology and infrastructure company focused on the tokenization and digitalization of commodity real-world assets. Streamex delivers institutional-grade solutions that bridge traditional finance and blockchain-enabled markets through secure, regulated, and yield-bearing financial instruments.


For more information, visit[www.streamex.com.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Zyt3LihELilgdVwqG5CYWnxQjUhdBS9WMvMr05b9iIoQKt39FlZ4ZOu0t6XQ92Dw3IaBIf26SvJGTNRyxAe3pl963HUHhMgRxGSpsh8ES7Y=)
